phases: G4A-2R Phase 3: six-dimensional action chain feedback and display-frame binding
G4A-2R Phase 4: preview decoupled from teaching recording

root_cause_fixed.defect: The page bound the human intent to the frame at intent-creation time but filled the action's display_sample_id with the CURRENT display frame; a newer frame between intent and action made the backend reject the action with 'display sample does not bind human intent' (repeated sends / 5Hz streams).
root_cause_fixed.fix: display_sample_id now always equals the intent's bound frame (intentSampleId); observation_sample_id carries the latest control observation. A changed target creates a new intent from the current frame; an unchanged target reuses the existing binding.

disabled_reasons: 没有新鲜成功显示的 RGB-D 画面
chain_feedback.readouts: target vs actual vs error table for joint1-5 and the gripper, refreshed from the observation stream
chain_feedback.postures: capabilities.g4a2_postures rendered as apply buttons; applying goes through the same gated action chain

preview_decoupling.behavior: Without an active Episode the backend keeps a single overwritten preview frame (rate limited to 2 Hz) under var/runs/_preview and serves observations marked quality=*_preview; the page shows a preview badge. Motion gates (recording + nearfield permission) are untouched: the send button stays disabled with '尚未开始真人录制'.
preview_decoupling.asset_registry: Recent per-sample asset paths are kept (64 entries) so the observation -> image fetch cannot lose the race against the 10 Hz sensor; older preview samples keep resolving.

state_smoke.notes: updated for the explicit-authorize flow; still covers normal stop, immediate finalizing, stop failure, broken image, displayed-sample binding

preview_regression.base_url: temporary static server serving the release's real g4a2.html/js
preview_regression.notes: capabilities GET allowed by the fixture; slow image, broken image and intent lineage checks unchanged

preview_probe.method: real MujocoBackend instance without an Episode
